scope: Real shared renderer and native Canvas pixels plus controlled DOM. Fixtures are not character art.

checks.name: Shared selector infers walking, retreat, air, crouch and blockstun from actual actor fields
Terminal poses and attack locking do not depend on absolute sprite position
Reaction clock begins on its state transition instead of final frame at match age
Clock pauses with simulation time and resets on seek or a new actor without mutation
Explicit frame scrub and committed attack tick override the passive clock
Clip-disabled fallback keeps the requested anatomical side and never a second reflection
A loading attack atlas renders the already-loaded same-side idle pixels
Broken directional action keeps valid lateral idle instead of a frontal reference
Native RE2 larva uses a measured complete silhouette and a declared bilateral reflection
Oblique animal references stay oblique even when approved to face the opponent
Atelier exposes all 21 states, exact stepping, scrub limits and real laboratory links
Atelier pauses on blur and hides stale actions for an empty search
Historical R3 preservation with explicitly checked R6 combat delta
